item.title: Taylor Swift Joins Travis Kelce at His Former Teammate’s Wedding One Week After Their Own
item.description:
[Intro music plays]
Host: Welcome back to our podcast! Today, we're talking about the one and only Taylor Swift. Wedding season is in full swing for the singer, and she's been making the rounds with her new husband, Travis Kelce.
[Soft music transitions in]
Host: Just last week, Swift and Kelce tied the knot at Madison Square Garden in New York City. And this weekend, they attended the wedding of NFL player JuJu Smith-Schuster and his wife, Laura Kruk, in Orange County, California. The ceremony took place at the beautiful Ritz-Carlton, Laguna Niguel, overlooking the ocean.
[Short sound clip of waves crashing]
Host: Swift was spotted in a stunning strapless, pink floral gown by Markarian, while Kelce was by her side. The couple was seen strolling hand-in-hand and seated during the service and festivities.
[Music transitions to a quick upbeat tune]
Host: In other news, Swift's original song "I Knew It, I Knew You" from the Toy Story 5 soundtrack debuted in the top 10 on three Billboard charts. And, she's currently dominating the Adult Contemporary songs chart with four spots in the top 10.
[Music slows down]
Host: And if that's not enough, Swift just received a Primetime Emmy nomination for her work on Taylor Swift/The Eras Tour/The Final Show. She's nominated as both a performer and producer in the category of outstanding variety special.
[Outro music plays]
Host: That's all for today, folks! Taylor Swift is definitely on a roll. We'll be keeping an eye on her latest projects and milestones. Thanks for tuning in, and we'll catch you in the next episode!
